signature.task_pattern: The parent criterion incorrectly prioritizes the mere presence of visual elements over their interpretive accuracy and relevance to the question.
signature.visual_focus: The parent criterion focuses on whether candidates mention any visual elements, without evaluating whether those elements are correctly interpreted or directly relevant to the question of passenger pickup.
signature.candidate_difference: Candidate A avoids referencing specific visual elements, while Candidate B references a bus stop under a bridge and nearby people — but these elements are not clearly visible or verifiable in the image, making B’s grounding misleading.
signature.parent_failure: The parent criterion failed to distinguish between correct and incorrect visual grounding. It rewarded Candidate B for mentioning any visual elements, even though those elements are ambiguous or not clearly observable, while penalizing Candidate A for not mentioning them — despite A’s more cautious, accurate interpretation based on what is actually visible.
